private pure subroutine basis_bspline_active_ders(Xt, knot, nc, degree, nder, first, N, dN, d2N)

Return local basis values and optional first or second derivatives. This convenience overload requests at most order two from basis_bspline_der_all_active and never forms a dense nc-vector.
